info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Autopays-v1-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Autopay Retrieval API allows users to access and retrieve a comprehensive list of autopay settings for utility billing. This endpoint is designed for utility service providers and billing systems that need to monitor and manage customer autopay preferences efficiently. With this API, developers can integrate autopay data into their applications, enhancing user experience and automating billing processes. Typical use cases include generating reports on customer autopay enrollment and reviewing existing autopay settings for compliance or system updates.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to check the current status of their autopay settings for billing. Users can verify whether autopay is enabled or disabled for their account.

requestBody.description: Request to retrieve billing autopay settings. This request does not require any additional parameters or information beyond the specified content type.

ListUtilityBillingAutopaysRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to billing and autopay. It is expected to contain a string value.
